props.caption: Glass and Glazing Area Limits — Maximum Light Areas by Type and Thickness
props.description: Reference diagram showing: maximum single-light areas for sheet glass (3mm=0.84sqm, 5mm=1.20sqm), polished plate (6mm=6.00sqm, 10mm=12.00sqm), and tempered glass (per manufacturer). Hazardous locations diagram highlighting doors, sidelites within 300mm of door edge, shower enclosures, and areas within 450mm of floor requiring safety glazing. Jalousie blade length limits (1.20m for 5mm, 1.50m for 6mm).
